notes: Chain location; work-list address 12314 Poway Road matches this DoorDash store's own FAQ address ('12314 Poway Rd, Poway, CA 92064') exactly. This restaurant's own Olo storefront (playbook: 'Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf's Olo storefront has defeated five attempts') was not retried; DoorDash was used instead as a different route. The page's schema.org JSON-LD Menu block only exposed 91 of the store's items across 7 sections (a curated subset -- Teas, Ice Blended drinks, Cold Brew, Cocoas, Retail were all missing from it) even though the page's own escaped Next.js RSC flight payload (self.__next_f.push, MenuBookCategory / MenuPageItemList / MenuPageItem objects) held the complete 24-category, 260-item catalog matching the category metadata's own numItems counts exactly. Used the RSC payload instead of the JSON-LD. Dropped the 'Most Ordered' carousel entirely (all 12 items were exact-name duplicates of items already present in their real categories). Dropped 3 items with no resolvable price ('Brewed Coffee' x2, 'Red Eye') per the never-write-a-dish-without-a-real-price rule -- these are build-your-own drinks whose modifier price could not be resolved from this payload (isEligible:false on the quick-add price with a $0 base). Items whose grid price is a 'from' price (build-your-own with required size/flavor choice) are noted as such in their description; the number recorded is the storefront's own displayed 'starting at' figure, not invented.
